help.intro: Every puzzle hides a pixel picture. The numbers beside each row and above each column are run clues: they tell you the lengths of the filled runs in that line, in order. A row clue of “2 1” means a run of two lit cells, at least one empty gap, then a single lit cell.
help.fill: Tap or click a cell in Fill mode to light it. A wrong fill counts a mistake and shows you the cross instead.
help.mark: Switch to Mark mode (or press X) to cross cells you know are empty. Crosses are notes — they never count as mistakes.
When every lit cell of a line is placed,: When every lit cell of a line is placed, the board crosses the rest of the line for you. Complete every lit cell to reveal the picture.
Points for lit cells, finishing under pa: Points for lit cells, finishing under par, and clean boards. Mistakes cost 50, hints cost 25. A flawless board earns +500.
